HEIGHTS
These rates cover every height we build, from 300mm up to 1.5m. We do not band our rates by
height — the wall system and who supplies the materials are what set the price per metre.

SITE CONDITIONS
Restricted access surcharge $450. Difficult ground labour $125 per hour.
Rock excavation $180 per hour.

ENGINEERING AND APPROVALS
Walls over 1m generally need engineering and a building permit, and a wall near a boundary or under a driveway can need approval below that. We arrange the engineering from $850 and council fees are the customer's.
Engineering and approvals are excluded unless the written quotation includes them. We never tell a customer approval is unnecessary without checking their particular site.

THE REST
All prices include GST. Based in Berwick, we travel 30km.

Travel outside our standard service area $95.
Ten year workmanship warranty on everything we build.
Not included: engineering, council permits, rock removal beyond normal digging, service
relocation, landscaping, turf, irrigation, and any fencing built on top of the wall.
